_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/agent-speak/config.json. Every key is optional and overrides the matching default in scripts/speak.ps1. It lives outside the plugin so a plugin update cannot overwrite your settings. Never put your API key here - it is read from the environment variable named by ElevenKeyVar.
_voice: A premade voice id works on every plan. Voice Library voices need a paid plan; on the free tier the API returns 402 and speech drops silently to the Windows SAPI voice.
_cost: Every character here is billed. The end-of-turn cue is one short sentence; this cap only bites when you play a full response back.
_fallback: Used when no key or voice id is configured. Free, offline, robotic.
_controls: Seek step for the skip keys, and how often the player checks for a pause.
_replay: Replaying skips assistant messages shorter than this, so 'Playing.' is never what gets read back.
_narration: Lines spoken during a turn: decisions the agent narrates, and one line per subagent that finishes. Set SpeakNarration to false for one utterance per turn, as before. These are billed like any other characters, so the queue is capped and the oldest waiting line is dropped first.
_microphone: Automatic speech waits while you are dictating. MicHoldApps is matched as a substring of the capturing app's path, so it survives version bumps - and it is a list rather than 'any microphone use' on purpose: Windows reports OBS, virtual cameras and conferencing apps as holding the microphone for as long as they are open, and gating on that would mean the machine never speaks again. Add Discord, Zoom or ms-teams to hold speech during calls too. The wait is capped so a microphone held open forever is a late line, not silence.
